info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Single CRM data retrieval API for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Receives a structured request generated from the user's natural-language CRM request and retrieves live Zoho CRM records. The API is the only CRM API exposed to Copilot Studio. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this API whenever current or live Zoho CRM information is required, including filtering, sorting, counting, comparing, and retrieving CRM records. First understand the user's question, select the correct CRM module and required Zoho CRM API fields, convert every user condition into structured filters, and send the structured request to this API. Treat the returned data array as authoritative and analyze every record in it. Never return only the first matching record and never invent CRM records. For every new CRM request, use limit 20 and offset 0. If pagination.more_records is true, show the available records from the returned page and explain that additional records are available; for an explicit continuation such as give me the next 20, show me more, next page, continue, or give me the next set, call this same endpoint again with the exact previous module, fields, filters, sort_field, and sort_order and change only offset to previous offset plus previous limit. Calculate offsets as previous offset 0 plus limit 20 equals next offset 20, then previous offset 20 plus limit 20 equals next offset 40. Never restart an explicit continuation at offset 0 or issue an unfiltered continuation request. If there is no previous CRM query/page context, ask the user which query to continue instead of guessing. If pagination.more_records is false, no more records are available. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1 and must not be exposed as separate operations.

post.summary: Retrieve live CRM data from a structured request
post.description: The only CRM operation exposed to Copilot Studio. Use it for live Zoho CRM records. Select the correct module and actual Zoho CRM API fields, convert each user condition into a structured filter, and send the request here. Analyze every record in the returned data array; do not invent records or claim a result is complete while pagination.more_records is true. Every new question starts with limit 20 and offset 0. For an explicit continuation such as give me the next 20, show me more, next page, continue, or give me the next set, call this same operation with the same module, fields, filters, sort_field, and sort_order, changing only offset to the previous offset plus previous limit. Thus offset 0 plus limit 20 becomes offset 20, and offset 20 plus limit 20 becomes offset 40. Never restart an explicit continuation at offset 0 or remove the previous filters. If no previous query/page context exists, ask for the CRM query instead of guessing. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1 and have no separate operations.

400.description: The structured CRM request failed validation or contains invalid JSON.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or retrieval failure.

fields.description: Non-empty list of actual Zoho CRM API field names required to answer the user's question. Never use human-readable display labels and select fields dynamically from the configured module mapping.

filters.description: Optional structured conditions used to filter CRM records. Multiple filters are combined as AND conditions.

sort_field.description: Zoho CRM API field used to sort the returned records.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records to return. The first request for a new question should normally use 20.

offset.description: Number of CRM records to skip for pagination. A new CRM question must start at 0; a continuation may use the next offset after the previous limit.

field.description: Zoho CRM API field on which the filter is applied.

value.description: Filter value. Numeric comparison values such as 50000 may be sent as strings by Copilot Studio and are interpreted by the backend for numeric comparisons. Use a scalar string for equals, contains, and comparisons; use the backend-supported scalar array for in and exactly two scalar values for between. Omit value for is_null and is_not_null.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

module.description: The Zoho CRM module from which the records were retrieved.

count.description: Number of CRM records returned in the current response.

data.description: The actual CRM records returned by Zoho CRM. Use this data to answer the user's request.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records returned in this response.

offset.description: Number of CRM records skipped before this response.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional CRM records are available beyond the current response.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

error.description: Structured error information returned by the backend.

details.description: Additional structured error details, when available.
